purpose: An inline message about a page or section, such as a warning, an error or a confirmation, with an optional action and dismiss.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning and colour. Defaults to info

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, for example Retry or Undo

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a Dismiss IconButton and is called when it is pressed

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Name of the dismiss control. Defaults to Dismiss

whenToUse: For a message that applies to the page or a section and should stay until resolved
For form-level errors summarised at the top
whenNotToUse: For a message about one field — use that field's errorMessage

anatomy: Tonal container with a 4px accent edge on the start side, status icon, title, body, actions and an optional dismiss IconButton
states: Fill `color-container-info` / `color-container-success` / `color-container-warning` / `color-container-danger` with the matching on-container text

a11yNotes: Danger and warning use role alert, so they are announced at once; info and success use role status
The icon is decorative; the title carries the meaning
Text is checked against its container at 4.5:1 in every theme
